sources: Rockstar Games official GTA VI announcement, December 2023
meta.notes: Official information only. Nothing beyond confirmed Rockstar material is recorded here; unannounced sections stay empty on purpose.

items.name: Lucia
items.summary: Confirmed by Rockstar as one of two playable protagonists, shown being released from prison in the first trailer.

items.name: Jason
items.summary: Confirmed by Rockstar as the second playable protagonist, partnered with Lucia in the Bonnie-and-Clyde premise.

items.name: Leonida
items.summary: Rockstar-confirmed state inspired by Florida, the game's setting.

items.name: Vice City
items.summary: Rockstar-confirmed modern-day Vice City within Leonida.
